_README: Maps a ground-truth pattern FILENAME STEM (the key used by the eval harness, e.g. 'DUL', 'componency', 'partof') to the ODPReco catalog ODP it corresponds to. The value is the ODP NAME as it appears in ODPReco/resources/odp_list (the '<Name> ODP' token, case-insensitive on the stem side). A value of null means 'this GT pattern has NO equivalent in ODPReco's fixed 73-ODP catalog' (unreachable in black-box mode -> contributes to the recall ceiling gap). Stems are matched case-insensitively after stripping the file extension. This map is consumed ONLY by black-box mode (mode A) of run_odpreco_eval.py: a recommended catalog ODP is counted as a hit for a GT pattern iff some stem maps to it. See the dataset analysis: github ~49% instance-weighted recall ceiling, noOBO ~33%.
